title: cell-free Methylated DNA by Immunoprecipitation and Sequencing (cfMeDIP) of human meningioma samples

publications.title: Spatially resolved single-cell analyses of human meningioma identify novel cell states influencing tumor microenvironment and progression.

needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-11), from a discovery-log LEAD describing this as liquid-biopsy cfMeDIP methylation data. Independently verified live via the EGA Metadata API: study EGAS50000001539 / dataset EGAD50000002214, num_samples=59, dataset_types 'Methylation profiling by high-throughput sequencing', technologies 'Illumina HiSeq X', access_type controlled, released 2026-04-21. Fetched all 59 registered EGAN sample records directly: all phenotype 'tumor', 35 female/24 male, subject IDs mostly 'MNG###' (predominantly MNG138-MNG187, above the MNG001-137 range used by the sibling EGAS50000001589/EGAS50000001556 snRNA+spatial atlas studies, but NOT strictly non-overlapping: four cfMeDIP subjects, MNG005, MNG006, MNG009 and MNG022, fall within the atlas MNG001-137 numbering, so a partial patient overlap with the tissue-atlas cohort cannot be ruled out from the shared MNG numbering scheme alone) plus 5 subjects labeled 'CAM20.00xx' (a different site/cohort naming convention, likely a Cambridge-based collaborating cohort); recorded as a standalone record with no related_accessions, but the four in-range MNG IDs are flagged for reviewer attention as possible cross-modality (liquid-biopsy vs tissue) same-patient links rather than duplicates. MODALITY DECISION (per explicit instruction to check controlled_vocabulary.md's exact wording): used 'cfdna_epigenomic' ('liquid-biopsy cell-free DNA methylation/hydroxymethylation profiling... distinct from tissue-based dna_methylation_array/dna_methylation_seq') rather than 'dna_methylation_seq', since cfMeDIP is precisely a cell-free/liquid-biopsy methylation immunoprecipitation-sequencing assay on plasma, exactly the use case this vocabulary term was added for. tissue_preservation set to 'liquid_biopsy' (the controlled-vocabulary value for blood/plasma/serum/CSF-derived samples, added 2026-07-11) since these are plasma cfDNA liquid-biopsy samples, not a solid-tissue specimen with a fresh-frozen/FFPE preservation method. No linked publication (pubmed_ids empty); this is a very recent (2026-04-21) raw-data-only deposition with no processed_data_format or pipeline information exposed via the public API. Only public EGA study/dataset/sample-level metadata was used per docs/scope.md; the controlled-access sequencing data itself was never accessed. tags.large_cohort left false pending the centralized post-hoc recomputation across the whole inventory (this record would likely be the largest cfdna_epigenomic cohort in the inventory once that recompute runs). (1) The prior claim that the MNG subject IDs were 'distinct from and non-overlapping with the MNG001-137 range' of the atlas studies was false; the live /studies/EGAS50000001539/samples list includes MNG005, MNG006, MNG009 and MNG022, which lie inside the atlas MNG001-094 (snRNA, EGAD50000002272) / MNG095-137 (spatial, EGAD50000002233) numbering, so overlap cannot be excluded from IDs alone; text reworded accordingly. (2) The note previously described tissue_preservation as set to 'not_applicable', but the actual field value is 'liquid_biopsy' (the correct vocab value added 2026-07-11); note text reconciled to the actual value. No field values other than this note text were changed for this record; patient_count/sample_count (59/59), sex_distribution (35 female/24 male, matching live biological_sex), platform (Illumina HiSeq X) and all other fields re-verified correct against the live EGA API this pass.
